name: @niq.run/msp-worker
description: MSP interface worker for niq — connects to an MSP world through the msp-ts SDK (vendored), exposes MSP tools/signals as niq capabilities, and lets MSP peers call back into niq.

scripts.release: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet || { echo "Error: git working tree not clean" >&2; exit 1; } && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm version --no-git-tag-version && npm publish
